content: To observe the phrase-level embeddings at a glance, we draw a scatter plot in which a point represents the corresponding intermediate representation. We utilize PCA (Principal Component Analysis) to project the representations into a two-dimensional vector space. As a target parse tree, we reuse the one seen in Figure 1 . The result is shown in Figure 4 .
